Tree ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

Display hierarchical nodes and let users expand, select, or check local data.

Basic usage and states ​

The following example uses the public features of this component.

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		v-bind="{
			data,
			nodeKey: 'id',
			showCheckbox: true,
			defaultExpandedKeys: ['root', 'release']
		}"
		@node-click="selected = $event.label"
		@check="
			(_, state) => {
				checked = state.checkedNodes.map((item) => item.label).join('、');
				partial = state.halfCheckedNodes.map((item) => item.label).join('、');
			}
		"
	>
		<template #default="{ data: item }">
			<span>{{ item.label }}</span>
		</template>
	</AsamTree>
	<div class="tree-state" role="status">
		<p>当前节点：{{ selected || '无' }}</p>
		<p>已勾选：{{ checked || '无' }}</p>
		<p>部分勾选：{{ partial || '无' }}</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTreeBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const data = [
	{
		id: 'root',
		label: '本地记录',
		children: [
			{ id: 'draft', label: '草稿' },
			{
				id: 'release',
				label: '发布资料',
				children: [
					{ id: 'readme', label: '接入说明' },
					{ id: 'changes', label: '更新记录' }
				]
			},
			{ id: 'locked', label: '锁定记录', disabled: true }
		]
	}
];
const selected = ref('');
const checked = ref('');
const partial = ref('');
</script>

<style scoped>
.tree-state {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-xs);
	margin-block-start: var(--asam-space-md);
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.tree-state > p {
	margin: 0;
}
</style>

Usage conventions ​

Map the actual label, children, and disabled fields with data and props. Supply a stable nodeKey for checkboxes and instance methods that operate on nodes. See the full notes.

Native usage and API ​

These examples use the pinned 2.14.7 release. Cascader and TreeSelect examples set value-mode="native" explicitly. Their native values, paths, field mappings, and callbacks apply to that mode. The API tables show native defaults. See the ASAM overrides and four size values in the usage notes.

Display information as a hierarchy with nodes that users can expand or collapse.

Selectable tree ​

Use checkboxes to select items in a hierarchy.

This example also shows how to load node data dynamically.

Example: native-selectable

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:props="props"
		:load="loadNode"
		lazy
		show-checkbox
		@check-change="handleCheckChange"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/selectable.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	name: string;
}

let count = 1;
const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones'
};

const handleCheckChange = (data: Tree, checked: boolean, indeterminate: boolean) => {
	console.log(data, checked, indeterminate);
};

const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'region1' }, { name: 'region2' }]);
	}
	if (node.level > 3) return resolve([]);

	let hasChild = false;
	if (node.data.name === 'region1') {
		hasChild = true;
	} else if (node.data.name === 'region2') {
		hasChild = false;
	} else {
		hasChild = Math.random() > 0.5;
	}

	setTimeout(() => {
		let data: Tree[];
		if (hasChild) {
			data = [
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				},
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				}
			];
		} else {
			data = [];
		}

		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};
</script>

Usage tip

When show-checkbox is enabled, check-on-click-leaf defaults to true. Clicking the leaf itself toggles its checked state.

Custom leaf nodes with lazy loading ​

The tree fetches a node's children when the node is clicked, so it initially shows an expand arrow for each node. When the fetch finds no children, the arrow disappears. Identify a node as a leaf ahead of time to skip rendering its arrow.

Example: native-custom-leaf

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree style="max-width: 600px" :props="props" :load="loadNode" lazy show-checkbox />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/custom-leaf.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	name: string;
	leaf?: boolean;
}

const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones',
	isLeaf: 'leaf'
};

const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'region' }]);
	}
	if (node.level > 1) return resolve([]);

	setTimeout(() => {
		const data: Tree[] = [
			{
				name: 'leaf',
				leaf: true
			},
			{
				name: 'zone'
			}
		];

		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};
</script>

	}
	if (node.level > 1) return resolve([]);
	setTimeout(() => {
		const data = [
			{
				name: 'leaf',
				leaf: true
			},
			{
				name: 'zone'
			}
		];
		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};
</script>

Retrying a lazy load ​

A lazy request for remote nodes may fail. Call reject to preserve the node state and let the request be retried.

Example: native-multiple-times-load

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree style="max-width: 600px" :props="props" :load="loadNode" lazy />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/multiple-times-load.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones',
	isLeaf: 'leaf'
};

let time = 0;
const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve, reject) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'region' }]);
	}
	time++;
	if (node.level >= 1) {
		setTimeout(() => {
			if (time > 3) {
				return resolve([
					{ name: 'zone1', leaf: true },
					{ name: 'zone2', leaf: true },
					{ name: 'zone3', leaf: true }
				]);
			} else {
				return reject();
			}
		}, 3000);
	}
};
</script>

Disabled checkboxes ​

You can disable a node's checkbox.

In the example, defaultProps maps disabled, and some nodes set disabled: true. Their checkboxes are disabled.

Default expansion and checked state ​

You can expand or check nodes when the tree initializes.

Set default-expanded-keys and default-checked-keys for the initial expansion and checked state. Set node-key to a field in the node data whose value is unique across the tree.

const setCheckedKeys = () => {
	treeRef.value!.setCheckedKeys([3], false);
};

	treeRef.value!.setCheckedKeys([], false);
};

	children: 'children',

};

];

Custom node content ​

Customize a node's content with elements such as buttons or icons.

Use the render-content render function or a scoped slot to customize tree node content. See the full notes.

Example: native-customized-node

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="custom-tree-container">
		<p class="example-paragraph">使用 render-content</p>
		<AsamTree
			ref="treeRef1"
			style="max-width: 600px"
			:data="dataSource"
			show-checkbox
			node-key="id"
			default-expand-all
			:expand-on-click-node="false"
			:render-content="renderContent"
		/>
		<p class="example-paragraph">使用作用域插槽</p>
		<AsamTree
			ref="treeRef2"
			style="max-width: 600px"
			:data="dataSource"
			show-checkbox
			node-key="id"
			default-expand-all
			:expand-on-click-node="false"
		>
			<template #default="{ node, data }">
				<div class="custom-tree-node">
					<span>{{ node.label }}</span>
					<div>
						<AsamButton type="default" link @click="append(data)">追加</AsamButton>
						<AsamButton
							style="margin-left: 4px"
							type="default"
							link
							@click="remove(node, data)"
						>
							删除
						</AsamButton>
					</div>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamTree>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTree, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/customized-node.vue

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type {
	AsamTreeRenderContentContext,
	AsamTreeRenderContentFunction,
	AsamTreeInstance
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Tree[];
}
type Node = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'];
type Data = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['data'];

let id = 1000;
const treeRef1 = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();
const treeRef2 = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();

const append = (data: Data) => {
	const newChild = { id: id++, label: 'testtest', children: [] };
	treeRef1.value?.append(newChild, data);
	treeRef2.value?.append(newChild, data);
};

const remove = (node: Node, data: Data) => {
	treeRef1.value?.remove(data);
	treeRef2.value?.remove(data);
};

const renderContent: AsamTreeRenderContentFunction = (h, { node, data }) => {
	return h(
		'div',
		{
			class: 'custom-tree-node'
		},
		[
			h('span', null, node.label),
			h('div', null, [
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'default',
						link: true,
						onClick: () => append(data)
					},
					{
						default: () => '添加'
					}
				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						link: true,
						style: 'margin-left: 4px',
						onClick: () => remove(node, data)
					},
					{
						default: () => '删除'
					}
				)
			])
		]
	);
};

const dataSource = ref<Tree[]>([
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '一级节点 1',
		children: [
			{
				id: 4,
				label: '二级节点 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						id: 9,
						label: '三级节点 1-1-1'
					},
					{
						id: 10,
						label: '三级节点 1-1-2'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		id: 2,
		label: '一级节点 2',
		children: [
			{
				id: 5,
				label: '二级节点 2-1'
			},
			{
				id: 6,
				label: '二级节点 2-2'
			}
		]
	},
	{
		id: 3,
		label: '一级节点 3',
		children: [
			{
				id: 7,
				label: '二级节点 3-1'
			},
			{
				id: 8,
				label: '二级节点 3-2'
			}
		]
	}
]);
</script>

<style>

Filtering tree nodes ​

You can filter the nodes shown in the tree.

Set filter-node-method to a filter function and call filter on the Tree instance with the search term.

Example: native-filtering

Show source
LicenseExample source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamInput
			:model-value="filterText"
			class="w-60 mb-2"
			placeholder="筛选关键字"
			@update:model-value="updateFilterText"
		/>

		<AsamTree
			ref="treeRef"
			style="max-width: 600px"
			class="filter-tree"
			:data="data"
			:props="defaultProps"
			default-expand-all
			:filter-node-method="filterNode"
		/>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamInput, AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/filtering.vue

import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

import type {
	AsamInputEmits,
	AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction,
	AsamTreeInstance
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Tree[];
}

const filterText = ref('');
const treeRef = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();

const updateFilterText = (value: AsamInputEmits['update:modelValue'][0]) => {
	filterText.value = String(value);
};

const defaultProps = {
	children: 'children',
	label: 'label'
};

watch(filterText, (val) => {
	treeRef.value!.filter(val);
});

const filterNode: AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction = (value: string, data) => {
	if (!value) return true;
	return data.label.includes(value);
};

const data: Tree[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '一级节点 1',
		children: [
			{
				id: 4,
				label: '二级节点 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						id: 9,
						label: '三级节点 1-1-1'
					},
					{
						id: 10,
						label: '三级节点 1-1-2'
					}
				]
			}

Tree API ​

Props ​

Name Description Type Default
data Tree data. arrayArray<{[key: string]: any}> —
empty-text Text to display when the tree is empty. string —
node-key Name of the field that uniquely identifies each node across the tree. string —
props Node field mappings. See the table below. object —
render-after-expand Render a node's children only after expanding the node for the first time. boolean true
load Loads subtree data. Used when lazy is true. Function(node, resolve, reject) => void —
render-content Render function for a tree node's content. Function(h, { node, data, store }) => void —
highlight-current Highlight the current node. boolean false
default-expand-all Expand all nodes by default. boolean false
expand-on-click-node Expand or collapse a node when its row is clicked. Defaults to true. Set it to false to expand or collapse only from the arrow. boolean true
check-on-click-node Check a node when its row is clicked. Defaults to false, which normally requires clicking the checkbox. See check-on-click-leaf for leaf rows. boolean false
check-on-click-leaf Toggle the checked state when a leaf node is clicked. boolean true
auto-expand-parent Automatically expand parents when a child node expands. boolean true
default-expanded-keys Keys of nodes expanded by default. arrayArray<string | number> —
show-checkbox Show a checkbox for each node. boolean false
check-strictly Keep parent and child checked states independent when checkboxes are visible. Defaults to false. boolean false
default-checked-keys Keys of nodes checked by default. arrayArray<string | number> —
current-node-key Key of the current node. string / number —
filter-node-method Filter predicate. Return true to show the node and false to hide it. Function(value, data, node) => boolean —
accordion Allow only one sibling node to be expanded at a time. boolean false
indent Horizontal indent in pixels between node levels. number 18
icon Custom tree node icon component. string / Component —
lazy Lazy-load child nodes. Use with load. boolean false
draggable Enable node dragging. boolean false
allow-drag Return false to prevent dragging the node. Function(node) => boolean —
allow-drop Determine whether a node accepts the current drop. Return false to block the drop. type is 'prev' for before the target, 'inner' for inside the target, or 'next' for after the target. Function(draggingNode, dropNode, type) => boolean —

Node field mapping ​

Prop Description Type Default
label Maps the label to a value in the node data. string / Function(data, node) => string —
children Maps child nodes to a field in the node data. string —
disabled Maps whether the node checkbox is disabled to a value in the node data. string / Function(data, node) => boolean —
isLeaf Maps whether the node is a leaf. Applies only when lazy is enabled. string / Function(data, node) => boolean —
class Custom node class. string / Function(data, node) => string —

Exposed methods ​

Use the Tree instance methods to inspect and update checked nodes, manage the current node, and change the tree.

Method Description Parameters
filter Filter the tree and hide excluded nodes. One argument passed as the first argument to filter-node-method.
updateKeyChildren Set new data for a node. Requires node-key. (key, data). The node key and its new data.
getCheckedNodes Return the checked nodes when show-checkbox is true. (leafOnly, includeHalfChecked). Both default to false. Set leafOnly to return only checked leaves and includeHalfChecked to also return indeterminate nodes.
setCheckedNodes Set the checked nodes. Requires node-key. (nodes, leafOnly). An array of node objects to check and a boolean. leafOnly defaults to false. Set it to true to check only leaves.
getCheckedKeys Return the keys of checked nodes when show-checkbox is true. (leafOnly). Defaults to false. Set it to true to return only checked leaf keys.
setCheckedKeys Set the checked nodes by key. Requires node-key. (keys, leafOnly). An array of node keys and a boolean. leafOnly defaults to false. Set it to true to check only leaves.
setChecked Set a node's checked state. Requires node-key. (key/data, checked, deep). The node key or data, the checked state, and whether to update child nodes recursively. The recursive update also applies with check-strictly enabled.
getHalfCheckedNodes Return the indeterminate nodes when show-checkbox is true. —
getHalfCheckedKeys Return the keys of indeterminate nodes when show-checkbox is true. —
getCurrentKey Return the current node key, or null when there is no current node. —
getCurrentNode Return the current node's data, or null when there is no current node. —
setCurrentKey Set the current node by key. Requires node-key. (key, shouldAutoExpandParent=true). The key to highlight. Pass null to clear the highlight. The second argument controls whether the parent automatically expands.
setCurrentNode Set the current node. Requires node-key. (node, shouldAutoExpandParent=true). The node to highlight and whether to automatically expand its parent.
getNode Find a Tree node by data or key. (data). The node data or key.
remove Remove a node. Requires node-key. (data). The data or node object to remove.
append Append a child to a node. (data, parentNode). Data for the new child, followed by the parent's data, key, or node object.
insertBefore Insert a node before the given node. (data, refNode). Data to insert, followed by the reference node's data, key, or node object.
insertAfter Insert a node after the given node. (data, refNode). Data to insert, followed by the reference node's data, key, or node object.

Events ​

Name Description Parameters
node-click Emitted when a node is clicked. Node data, the node typed as AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], the context itself, and the event object.
node-contextmenu Emitted when a node is right-clicked. Event object, node data, the node typed as AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], and the context itself.
check-change Emitted when a node's checked state changes. Node data, whether the node is checked, and whether its subtree contains a checked node.
check Emitted after clicking a node's checkbox. Data for the node that was checked or unchecked, followed by a tree check state object with checkedNodes, checkedKeys, halfCheckedNodes, and halfCheckedKeys.
current-change Emitted when the current node changes. Current node data and the node typed as AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'].
node-expand Emitted when a node expands. Expanded node data, the node typed as AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], and the context itself.
node-collapse Emitted when a node collapses. Collapsed node data, the node typed as AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], and the context itself.
node-drag-start Emitted when a node starts being dragged. Dragged node data and the event object.
node-drag-enter Emitted when a dragged node enters another node. Dragged node data, entered node data, and the event object.
node-drag-leave Emitted when a dragged node leaves another node. Dragged node data, exited node data, and the event object.
node-drag-over Emitted when a dragged node moves over another node, similar to the browser's mouseover event. Dragged node data, data for the node under the drag, and the event object.
node-drag-end Emitted when dragging ends, including unsuccessful drops. Dragged node data, data for the node where the drag ended (which may be undefined), the placement before, after, or inner, and the event object.
node-drop Emitted after a successful drop. Dragged node data, drop target node data, the placement before, after, or inner, and the event object.

Slots ​

Name Description Type
default Custom tree node content. object{ node: UnwrapRef<RootTreeType['root']>, data: Tree | TreeOptionProps }
empty Custom content for an empty tree. —

Usage and contract notes ​

Usage conventions ​

Map the actual label, children, and disabled fields with data and props. Supply a stable nodeKey for checkboxes and instance methods that operate on nodes. Use showCheckbox, checkStrictly, defaultExpandedKeys, defaultCheckedKeys, lazy, load, draggable, filtering, and node events according to their public contracts. The default scoped slot provides node and data, and the empty slot handles empty data. The instance exposes methods for selection, filtering, and node updates. Tree and virtualized Tree V2 have separate APIs. Supply the host's load function for remote loading.

Custom node content ​

Use the render-content render function or a scoped slot to customize tree node content. The render function returns the node content. See the Vue documentation for syntax. The scoped slot provides node and data, corresponding to AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] and the current node data. JSX render functions require JSX support. Configure the project's compiler to use them. JSFiddle sessions without JSX support cannot run the JSX example.

allowDrop

this function will be executed before the dragging node is dropped. If `false` is returned, the dragging node can not be dropped at the target node. `type` has three possible values: 'prev' (inserting the dragging node before the target node), 'inner' (inserting the dragging node to the target node) and 'next' (inserting the dragging node after the target node)
